title: The family house: no indoor bath, first electricity
summary: Crowded three-room house, outside toilet, kerosene lamps, the grate and the first electric bulb.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: That's good. You were an only child, but did you have, how big was the house you grew up in?
Three rooms in the kitchen. Three rooms in the kitchen?
Yeah. So was it like a lot of people in one room?

Well I was on the couch. Well like I said my brothers were older so they lived, my brother had his wife and my other brother had his wife. And one of my sisters Thelma, she lived in California. So it was like my older sister and my younger sister who I was next to Cleo and my mom. And my sister wasn't really overcrowded all the time. Like I said I had the couch, I had the bed. You know it was like the living room, two bedrooms, kitchen. And at first we didn't have the indoor bath. The toilet was outside. Oh even when you were going out?
Was that a privy? Was that a privy?

I mean what was it? Oh yeah, yeah. It was connected to the house. You'd go out to the house and make a ride. Make a ride. If it rain, it was cold, you'd bring a little paper in there and warm it up. Put the fire in there. Finally built an indoor bathroom. I can remember when we first had electricity. I was very small and I thought it was a miracle because I had the lamps when I was a child. You had oil?

We had the grate, they called it the fireplace, the grate. And that was it. There was no fire, nothing wasn't popping out. There was one we put potatoes under the ashes and baked the potatoes. But then we, somebody got lucky, my daddy got a raise or something. It was electricity, it turned on about a 25 watt bulb. And that's when it was a miracle. I'm so used to the lamps.

But a number three tub. Back to the dew drop thing. I'd come home and take a bath and go to school. My mother had the tub. Sit in the front of the grate, not the fireplace, in the front of the grate. And I'd sit there in the number three tub and take a bath. And lay down and fix me some breakfast and I'd get up and I'd go to school.
